about: Every test of @agentcc/client 1.0.1 (agent-command-center-sdk client-patch-source, sdk/typescript/tests) as vitest ran it: per file, in run order, the full name (describe titles and the test title joined by " > "; vitest JSON reports a leading empty ancestor title for the file, dropped here) and the status. 420 tests: 378 passed, 42 failed (all 42 in the four live-gateway files, which need a gateway on localhost:8090; 10 tests in those files pass without one).
